source: Trench Crusade Core Rulebook PDF + Warbands of Trench Crusade PDF + Changelog 1.0.2
notes: Keywords and faction rules extracted directly from official PDFs (version 1.0.2). Bayonet Lug and Shield Combo are stipulations defined in Warbands of Trench Crusade, not keyword glossary entries. Naval Raiding Party special rules extracted verbatim from Warbands of Trench Crusade p124.

description.content: Dice that are added to or subtracted from Success Rolls. For each +DICE, add one die to the 2D6 pool and pick the two highest results. For each -DICE, add one die and pick the two lowest results. If the Keyword applies to a Weapon, the dice are only added to Success Rolls for Attacks made with it.
Add one extra die to the roll and pick the lowest two results. This makes success less likely.
Add one extra die to the roll and pick the lowest two results. This makes success less likely.

Dice that are added to or subtracted from Injury Rolls. If the Keyword applies to a Weapon, the dice are only added to Injury Rolls for Attacks made with it. A higher Injury Roll result means a more severe injury on the Injury Table.
Add +1 die to the Injury Roll for attacks made with this weapon. Roll 3D6 and pick the two highest results. A higher result means a more severe injury on the Injury Table.
Add -1 die to the Injury Roll for attacks made with this weapon. Roll 3D6 and pick the two lowest results. A lower result means a less severe injury on the Injury Table.
Modifiers that are applied to the final result of an Injury Roll. If the Keyword applies to a Weapon, the modifier is only applied to Injury Rolls for Attacks made with it.
Add +2 to the final result of the Injury Roll for attacks made with this weapon. A higher result means a more severe injury outcome on the Injury Table.
Subtract 1 from the final result of the Injury Roll for attacks against a model with this. A lower result means a less severe injury outcome on the Injury Table.
Subtract 2 from the final result of the Injury Roll for attacks against a model with this. A lower result means a less severe injury outcome on the Injury Table.

An activity a model can carry out when it is Activated. Common ACTIONS include Move, Dash, Shoot and Fight. A model cannot take more than one of the same type of ACTION per Activation unless stated otherwise.

If a model has a piece of Battlekit with this Keyword, it will use it in the next game. When the model is deployed, say which Ranged Weapon the Battlekit will be used for — it gains the (KEYWORD) until the end of the game. The Ranged Weapon cannot have the BLAST, FIRE, GAS, or SHRAPNEL Keywords, and cannot have more than one type of AMMUNITION.

A Weapon with this Keyword reduces the target's total -INJURY MODIFIER from its Armour Characteristic, and/or any Armour or Shields it has, by 1, to a minimum of 0. For example, if a target had Standard Armour and a Trench Shield, the -INJURY MODIFIER would be lowered from -2 to -1.
This model is not of natural biological origin but is instead constructed from non-organic elements.
Ranged Attacks made with Weapons that have this Keyword do not prevent a model from taking a Charge or Fight ACTION during the same Activation.

When you take a Shoot ACTION with a Ranged Weapon that has this Keyword, you can make a number of Ranged Attacks with this weapon equal to X, one after another. Attacks can target different enemy models as long as they are all within 6" of each other. Any BLOOD MARKERS or BLESSING MARKERS spent only modify the Injury Roll for the Ranged Attack they are spent on.

A stipulation on a Ranged Weapon. You must purchase a Ranged Weapon with a Bayonet Lug before you can purchase a Bayonet Melee Weapon for that model. The Bayonet attaches to the firearm and is used in melee combat.

This weapon has a blast radius in inches equal to X (including vertically). Pick a target — either an enemy model or a visible point — within Line of Sight and range. On a Failure, the attack misses unless the weapon also has SCATTER. On a Success or Critical Success, every model within the blast radius that has Line of Sight to the target is hit, plus friendly models within 1" of a hit enemy. Make an Injury Roll for every model hit. On a Critical Success, only add the extra INJURY DICE for the originally targeted model.

This weapon has a 3" blast radius. Every model within 3" that has Line of Sight to the target is hit on a Success or Critical Success. Friendly models within 1" of a hit enemy are also hit. Make an Injury Roll for every model hit.
When you deploy a model with this Keyword for the first time in a game, place a number of BLESSING MARKERS beside the model equal to X.
The model is under the influence of a supernatural or chemical enhancement that provides temporary benefits. Blessing Markers can be spent to improve Injury Rolls for friendly models.
Add -1 DICE for Melee Attacks targeting a model with this Keyword, or that has a Weapon with this Keyword, if the attacker made a Charge ACTION before making the attack this Turn.

BLOOD MARKERS are placed on models that suffer injuries. Opponents can spend a model's BLOOD MARKERS to add -1 DICE to that model's action rolls, or spend 6 BLOOD MARKERS (3 if the target is Down) to convert an Injury Roll into a Bloodbath Roll (roll 3D6, add all three together).

When you take a Fight ACTION with a Weapon that has this Keyword, you can make a number of Melee Attacks equal to X, one after another. The attacks can target different enemy models as long as they are all within 1" of the attacking model. Any BLOOD MARKERS spent only modify the Injury Roll for the attack they are spent on.
In a campaign, Battlekit with this Keyword is lost at the end of a game in which it is used.

A model has Cover if it is in contact with a terrain piece that is at least ½" high, at least as wide as its base, and the terrain piece lies between it and the attacker in a way that partially blocks Line of Sight. Add -1 DICE to Ranged Attacks targeting a model in Cover.
Add +2 INJURY DICE instead of the usual +1 INJURY DICE when a Critical Success is rolled for an attack made by a Weapon with this Keyword.
Weapons with this Keyword require two hands to use, even if the model has the STRONG Keyword. However, they can still be used alongside a Shield if both have the Shield Combo stipulation.

When you make an Injury Roll for an attack with this Keyword, roll 3D6 and add all 3 dice together. Any +INJURY DICE or -INJURY DICE are added normally, except that you pick the 3 highest or lowest dice instead of the 2 highest or lowest.
A model with this Keyword has the NEGATE FIRE Keyword.
The most senior and heroic models in a Warband. They have different rules for experience and advancement, and often enjoy a different weapon, armour and equipment selection.
Add -1 DICE to a Melee Attack that targets a model with this Keyword. Models that cause FEAR are immune to FEAR themselves.
After making the Injury Roll for a Weapon with this Keyword, place 1 extra BLOOD MARKER next to the target model even if the result is No Effect.

A model with this Keyword is part of a group of 2 models that can be Activated simultaneously. Take their ACTIONS in any order, switching freely between models. If the Activation of either member ends, it immediately ends for the other too. A model cannot be in more than 1 Fireteam.
When a Weapon with this Keyword is used to make a Ranged Attack it is automatically a Success — do not make a Success Roll. Note that this means the attack cannot achieve a Critical Success.

When moving, retreating or charging, you can measure the path through the air. The model must end on the battlefield or a terrain piece. Still take a Risky Success Roll if activated or ending on Dangerous terrain. Cannot end on Impassable terrain. Do not make an Injury Roll if this model Falls.
After making the Injury Roll for a Weapon with this Keyword, place 1 extra BLOOD MARKER next to the target model even if the result is No Effect.

Treats an Out of Action result as a Down result unless caused by a Bloodbath Roll. You cannot remove BLOOD MARKERS from a friendly model with this Keyword. Has NEGATE FEAR and NEGATE GAS Keywords, but cannot have the TOUGH Keyword.
A thrown explosive device. Grenades use the Ranged Attack sequence and the model's Ranged Characteristic.

A model cannot be equipped with more than one piece of Battlekit with this Keyword and does not receive a Charge Bonus. If a Ranged Weapon or Grenade has this Keyword, you cannot use it to make a Ranged Attack and take a Move, Charge, Retreat, or Dash ACTION in the same Activation.

Requires one hand to carry and cannot be put down. A model with this Keyword can only be equipped with either a 1-Handed Weapon or a Shield — not a 2-Handed Weapon, and not both a Weapon and a Shield. It may still carry Grenades.
The model is a member of the Heretic Legions Faction.
Ignore -INJURY DICE and -INJURY MODIFIERS for a target's Armour Characteristic, and for any Armour or Shield pieces of Battlekit that it has, for attacks that have this Keyword.
Ignore the Success Roll or Injury Roll modifier that is specified. For example, IGNORE COVER means the attack is not affected by the -1 DICE modifier for a target in Cover.
Ignore the -1 DICE modifier to the Success Roll that would normally apply when the target is in Cover.
Ignore the -1 DICE modifier to the Success Roll that would normally apply when attacking at Long Range (beyond half the weapon's range).
Ignore the +1 DICE bonus that would normally apply when the attacker is in an elevated position at least 3" higher than the target.
Ignore the specified armour modifier when making Injury Rolls against the target.

The ARMOUR PIERCING and IGNORE ARMOUR Effects do not affect any -INJURY DICE and -INJURY MODIFIERS that apply to Battlekit that has this Keyword. Any other Battlekit the target model has is affected normally.

When this model is deployed for the first time in a game, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield as long as it is out of the Line of Sight of all enemies and is at least 8" away from the closest enemy. INFILTRATORS are deployed after models without this Keyword. Any INFILTRATORS that cannot be deployed this way are deployed normally in their deployment zone.
Add +1 DICE to Morale Checks if your Warband has at least 1 model with this Keyword on the battlefield that is not Down or Out of Action.

When a model moves into contact with a Marker or terrain piece with this Keyword, the mine detonates unless the model has NEGATE MINED. Make an Injury Roll with the SHRAPNEL Keyword for the detonating model, then the Marker or terrain piece loses the MINED Keyword. Models with the FLYING Keyword only detonate a mine if they finish a move in contact with it.
A model with the NEGATE Keyword is not affected by the specified Keyword's Effect. For example, a model with NEGATE SHRAPNEL ignores the Effect of the SHRAPNEL Keyword.
This model is not affected by the FIRE Keyword's Effect — it does not receive the extra BLOOD MARKER from attacks with the FIRE Keyword.
This model is not affected by the GAS Keyword's Effect — it does not receive the extra BLOOD MARKER from attacks with the GAS Keyword.
This model is not affected by the FEAR Keyword's Effect — it does not suffer the -1 DICE penalty to Melee Attacks against models with FEAR.
This model is not affected by the HEAVY Keyword's restrictions. It can equip and use one 2-Handed Melee Weapon as if it were a 1-Handed Melee Weapon.
This model is not affected by the SHRAPNEL Keyword's Effect — it does not receive the extra BLOOD MARKER from attacks with the SHRAPNEL Keyword.

Can be used as a Melee Weapon or a Ranged Weapon, and as both in the same Activation. When used as a Ranged Weapon it uses the Range shown on its Profile and the model's Ranged Characteristic. When used as a Melee Weapon it can use the model's Ranged or Melee Characteristic and can be used as an Off-Hand Weapon.
If a model makes an attack with a Weapon that has this Keyword, its Activation ends after the ACTION that allowed the attack is completed.
When you Activate a model with this Keyword, before carrying out any ACTIONS, you can remove up to X BLOOD MARKERS from the model.

If you must make a Success Roll for a model using a piece of Battlekit with this Keyword, the Success Roll becomes a Risky Success Roll — the model's Activation or ACTION will end if the roll is a Failure. This Effect is ignored if the roll is already a Risky Success Roll.

Some Weapons with BLAST also have SCATTER. If the Success Roll is a Failure, the attack scatters instead of missing. Subtract the Success Roll from 7 to find the scatter distance in inches (e.g. a roll of 4 scatters 3"). Your opponent moves the attack that many inches in a direction of their choice. There must be Line of Sight between the new point and the original target. Then determine who is hit as per BLAST rules.
Add -1 INJURY DICE to rolls for attacks made at Long Range with a Weapon that has this Keyword instead of the usual Long Range modifier (-1 DICE to hit).
After making the Injury Roll for a Weapon with this Keyword, place 1 extra BLOOD MARKER next to the target model even if the result is No Effect.
A model can have a Shield and a 2-Handed Weapon if both have the Shield Combo stipulation. Normally a Shield prevents a model from carrying a 2-Handed Weapon.

If an enemy selects this model as the target of a Charge, you can choose to evade before the Charge is made, as long as the model is not within 1" of an enemy. Roll a D3 and move the model that many inches, finishing more than 1" from all enemy models. If an interposing model results, the charger must choose that model as the new target instead.
A model with this Keyword has the NEGATE HEAVY Keyword. In addition, it can equip and use one 2-Handed Melee Weapon as if it were a 1-Handed Melee Weapon.
The first time a model with this Keyword suffers an Out of Action result on the Injury Table, it is treated as a Down result instead. This only applies once per game.
Add -1 INJURY DICE to rolls for an Artillery Witch that has been hit by an attack with the GAS Keyword.
You may include 0-2 Artillery Witches in a Warband if the total cost of all of the other models in the Warband (including their Battlekit) adds up to 1,000 Ducats or more.

You can upgrade Heretic Troopers in your Warband to Heretic Legionnaires, at a cost of +10 Ducats each. You cannot upgrade a Heretic Trooper if doing so would result in there being more Heretic Legionnaires in your Warband than there are Heretic Troopers. When you upgrade a Heretic Trooper to a Heretic Legionnaire, you can change either their Ranged Characteristic or their Melee Characteristic from 0 to +1.
You do not have to take a Risky Success Roll for an Artillery Witch when they Climb or Jump, or an Injury Roll if they Fall.

A Heretic Priest can take a Puppet Master ACTION. If they do so, take a Risky Success Roll for the model. If the roll is a Failure, the Heretic Priest’s Activation ends immediately. If the roll is a Success or Critical Success, pick 1 model (friend or foe) that is within 12” of the Heretic Priest and in their Line of Sight, apart from the Heretic Priest themselves. You can move the model D6”. The move must be in a straight line but can be in any direction, and can be used to make the model move within 1” of an enemy, make a retreat move, Climb, Jump, or Jump Down. The model cannot make a Diving Charge and does not count as charging if it finishes the move within 1” of an enemy model.
Add -1 DICE to rolls for Ranged Attacks that target a Death Commando.

A Death Commando can take a Hide ACTION if they are in contact with a terrain piece that is at least ½” high. If they do so, take a Risky Success Roll for the model and add +1 DICE to the roll. If the roll is a Failure, the Death Commando’s Activation ends immediately. If the roll is a Success or Critical Success, enemy models cannot choose the Death Commando as the target for a Ranged Attack or Charge until the Death Commando moves, charges, retreats, makes a Ranged Attack, or an enemy model moves within 1.5” of them. The Death Commando can be hit if they are within the blast radius of a Weapon with the BLAST Keyword.
In a campaign, Wretched can be sold in the Quartermaster Step for 25 Ducats plus half the cost in Ducats of any Battlekit they have.

When a Wretched is taken Out of Action, place 1 BLESSING MARKER next to the nearest friendly model with the ELITE and HERETIC Keywords. If two or more eligible models are equally close to the Wretched, you can choose which receives the BLESSING MARKER.

If an attack made by a Wretched takes an enemy model with the ELITE Keyword Out of Action, the Wretched model gains its freedom and is immediately removed from the game. It no longer counts as being part of the Warband for the purposes of Morale Checks and is removed from the Warband Roster.

A Death Commando can be set up anywhere on the battlefield as long as it is out of the Line of Sight of all enemies and is at least 8” away from the closest enemy. INFILTRATORS are deployed after models that do not have this Keyword.
Add +1 DICE to the Risky Success Roll for models from a Heretic Naval Raiders Warband that are taking a Dash ACTION.
Submachine Guns cost 25 Ducats for a Heretic Naval Raiders Warband.
A Heretic Naval Raiders Warband cannot include a War Wolf.
A Heretic Naval Raiders Warband cannot have more than two Anointed models or more than 1 Artillery Witch (even if the Warband has a value of 1,000 Ducats or more).
Up to three models without the ELITE Keyword in a Heretic Naval Raiders Warband can be given the INFILTRATOR Keyword at a cost of +10 Ducats each.
